info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Realestate Listings Favorites-v3-spec
info.description: This API enables users to access their favorite real estate listings, providing a curated view of properties they are interested in. By retrieving this data, consumers such as real estate agents and potential buyers can easily track and manage their preferred listings. The API offers a straightforward method to fetch favorites, streamlining the user experience in property search and selection. It is particularly useful in applications that enhance user engagement with personalized listings.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of favorite listings.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to obtain their favorite listings from the platform. It returns a collection of listings that the user has marked as favorites, facilitating easy access to preferred options.

requestBody.description: This endpoint retrieves a list of favorite listings for the authenticated user. The request body must include the necessary parameters to filter or customize the response, adhering to the defined schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of favorite listings.
